details.name: String Comparison (Case 1)
details.description: Construct the program that first checks the equality of the strings "HELLO WORLD!" and "hello world!" and then modifies the string "HELLO WORLD!" so that it matches the string "Hello Dave!".

details.name: String Comparison (Case 2)
details.description: Construct the program that modifies the string "hexxo worxd!" so that it matches (ignoring case) the string "HELLO WORLD!".
